stories.headline: Nvidia weighs anchor role in Anthropic mega-IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic is discussing an IPO of up to $100 billion at a valuation near $2 trillion, sources said, with Nvidia considering up to $10 billion as an anchor investor. Terms and timing could change.

stories.headline: Senators negotiate duty-of-care rules for AI
stories.summary: US senators are negotiating a bill that could require frontier AI developers to mitigate known catastrophic risks and let the federal government block unsafe releases. The text is unfinished and the legislative calendar is tight.

stories.headline: Anthropic details alleged misuse of Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic says it disrupted accounts using Claude for biological research, weapons software and cyber operations. The claims come from the company's threat report; several actors and institutions were not identified.

stories.headline: Saudi oil bypass pipeline shut after drone attack
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia shut its East-West oil pipeline after a drone attack reportedly launched from Iraq. The route had moved 4–5 million barrels daily around Hormuz; responsibility remains unclear.

stories.headline: Xi visits India as BRICS leaders meet
stories.summary: Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi for his first India visit in seven years and talks with Narendra Modi. The meeting signals cautious repair after the 2020 border clash, but core disputes remain.
